name: Prospector Ironband
summary: At Ironband's Excavation Site, Prospector Ironband leads a search through Khaz Modan's buried past. He directs the Dwarven Explorers' Guild's work in southeastern Loch Modan, seeking the heritage of the dwarven people. Despite setbacks and hostile creatures, he sends reports and relics to Ironforge.

sections.title: Unearthing the Past
sections.body: Prospector Ironband leads the dig at Ironband's Excavation Site in southeastern Loch Modan. Like other field researchers in the Explorers' Guild, he believes Khaz Modan's soil holds truths about the origins of the dwarven race. His camp digs trenches and sifts rubble for ancient relics, stone tablets, and earthen artifacts. The work is slow, but Ironband remains resolute and welcomes capable travelers who can safeguard the operation.

sections.title: Frontier Troubles
sections.body: Troggs and wildlife threaten the excavation in Loch Modan's rugged wilds. They endanger the dig's supplies and equipment, and relics or survey tools may be stolen or wrecked before the Guild can examine them. Ironband relies on visiting Alliance travelers to guard cargo shipments and hold off raiders. He also asks them to look into missing Guild contacts in the neighboring badlands.

faq.answer: Prospector Ironband leads the Dwarven Explorers' Guild's archaeological dig in southeastern Loch Modan. He directs field work to recover relics of titan and earthen history.

faq.q: Where can I find Prospector Ironband?
faq.answer: You can find Prospector Ironband at Ironband's Excavation Site, in the hills of southeastern Loch Modan, just east of the main road toward the southern border.

faq.q: What is the Explorers' Guild digging for here?
faq.answer: The Explorers' Guild digs through ancient stone ruins across Khaz Modan to learn the origins of the dwarven people and uncover artifacts left by the Titans.

faq.q: Why does Ironband need adventurers to protect shipments?
faq.answer: Ironband's dig depends on blastpowder and supplies shipped from Thelsamar across Loch Modan. One earlier powder shipment never arrived, Dark Iron dwarves threaten porters on the road, and troggs harass the camp.

faq.q: Who is Agmond and why does Ironband ask about him?
faq.answer: Agmond was a dwarf surveyor who went south to scout excavations. When contact was lost, Ironband asked travelers to search the Badlands and learn what had become of him.

faq.q: Is Prospector Ironband related to Bardin Ironband?
faq.answer: Darteus Ironband and Bardin Ironband share a surname and both work closely with frontier dwarf operations, which suggests they may be kin. Darteus remains focused on archaeology and Guild reports.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can take pride in Prospector Ironband's work to understand dwarven ancestry, part of King Magni's effort to learn the people's past.
As a miner, you know the pickaxes and trenching used at Ironband's dig. A sharp eye can reveal worked stone and buried layers among the rock.
As an Alliance traveler, you can help supply and defend Ironband's site, secure southeastern Loch Modan against trogg incursions, and preserve valuable relics for the Alliance.
